challenges.eyebrow: Everyday life in Irish home care
challenges.title: Travel time, HSE requirements and the Tyco ruling

items.title: Travel time counts as working time
items.text: Under the CJEU Tyco ruling (C-266/14), applied via the OWTA by the WRC and the Labour Court, it isn't only travel between clients that counts as working time — for staff with no fixed place of work, the first journey from home to the first client and the last journey back count too.

items.title: HSE Home Support Authorisation Scheme
items.text: The 2023 HSE scheme pays provider organisations a fixed rate of €31 per hour, while also requiring them to pay carers at least the Living Wage and to remunerate travel time between clients.

items.title: Changing routes, many clients
items.text: Home Support teams look after several clients a day at changing locations — by hand, it's almost impossible to track which travel time counts as working time where, and where the Living Wage obligation applies.

solutions.title: How Klacks takes the load off home care in Ireland
solutions.subtitle: From automatic routing to documented travel time — it all fits together.

items.title: Routes optimised automatically
items.text: Klacks lays out visit routes so that journeys stay short and time windows are kept — whether by car, bike or on foot.

items.title: Travel time stored as working time
items.text: In line with the Tyco ruling, journeys between clients and, for staff with no fixed place of work, also the first and last journey count as working time — in Klacks, you set up a fixed travel-time value per visit for this, which counts as working time; Klacks does not calculate individual travel times. Klacks does not automatically distinguish between staff with and without a fixed place of work.

items.title: HSE remuneration: hours basis
items.text: Klacks does not calculate the Living Wage rate or the travel-time remuneration under the 2023 HSE Home Support Authorisation Scheme — Klacks provides the planned hours as a basis for your payroll records.

items.title: Qualifications taken into account automatically
items.text: Every visit is only assigned to staff with the matching qualification — with no manual checking at all. If a required qualification is missing or has expired, Klacks refuses the assignment, in manual planning too — only staff with a valid qualification are scheduled.

items.title: Installed on your premises: data stored on your servers
items.text: Klacks runs on your own infrastructure. Patient data is stored on your servers — with a locally hosted AI model, no AI request goes to an external AI provider.

items.title: Klacksy understands your request
items.text: "Fill the routes for tomorrow" is enough. If someone calls in sick, Klacksy immediately suggests available cover.

example.title: Travel time, HSE scheme, one plan
example.text: Klacks takes into account the fixed travel-time value per visit between clients — and, if you wish, for the first and last journey — as working time, and provides the hours basis for the requirements of the HSE Home Support Authorisation Scheme — no manual recalculating required.
